Start: Peregrin Took (battlefield); Cauldron Familiar (battlefield); Goblin Bombardment (battlefield); Skeleton Crew (battlefield)

Color identity: BRG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite creature tokens with haste; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to any other creature you control  ); Dragonlord Kolaghan (battlefield); Living Hive (battlefield)
Prerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
  Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase.
